snippet.title: Punch Lunch: Foodtruck Fighter - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
The dish contains no allergens, but may include Streets Of Rage-like action in a classic GTA-style city with Overcooked / Dave The Diver inspired cooking & time management minigames! PUNCH LUNCH is a casual single-player adventure featuring a spicy mix of punchy street action and quirky food-sim.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3976200/Punch_Lunch_Foodtruck_Fighter/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:

https://indie-credible.com
